comment: pickup.c in_container() 2666 and 2675-2682: a debug Valkyrie level-teleports into Akalapi's general store on Dlvl 3 (the shop seed of the dokick.c shop recipe), sells a wished wand of cancellation and picks it up again, so it is unpaid. She drops a wished bag of holding (declining to sell it) and #loots it, putting the unpaid wand in: the bag explodes, the wand is billed before it is destroyed (2666), and because the bag lies on a costly square it is billed too, keeping its no_charge flag (2675-2682). The 6d6 blast kills her and she declines to die.
